create_pegasus_x_config: create a PegasusXConfig instance to initialize a PEGASUS-X encoder-decoder model configuration
initialize_pegasus_x_model: initialize a PegasusXModel with random weights using a PegasusXConfig instance
configure_pegasus_x_encoder: configure PEGASUS-X encoder with custom block_size, num_global_tokens, and stagger_local_blocks settings
access_model_config: access the PegasusXModel configuration via model.config to read encoder and decoder hyperparameters
customize_pegasus_x_hyperparameters: customize PegasusXConfig hyperparameters like d_model, encoder_layers, vocab_size, and dropout for PEGASUS-X
